name: Intel Gaudi 3 AI Accelerator Technical Paper - HL-338 PCIe Add-In Card TDP and CEM form factor (VERBATIM)
notes: VERBATIM: 'The Intel Gaudi 3 AI accelerator PCIe add-in card is offered to system designers in accordance with PCIe CEM Spec. Revision 5.1 form and supports up to 600W TDP Power with passive cooling.' Vendor-stated 600 W for the PCIe card form. IMPORTANT for the record: data/accelerators/intel-gaudi3.json's name spans BOTH forms ('HL-325 OAM / HL-338 PCIe') and its tdp_w is null; the two forms differ (900 W OAM vs 600 W PCIe), so the single-field schema cannot represent this without choosing a form factor and saying so. The Gaudi 2 record's 600 W comes from Table 8's OAM column, so the coincidence of the two 600 W figures is NOT a match - Table 8's Gaudi 2 = 600 W (OAM), Gaudi 3 = 900 W (OAM); Table 4's Gaudi 3 PCIe card = 600 W.
